title: Cosmic Expansion
description: Sum shortest galaxy pair distances in an expanding universe.
writeup:
## Approach

Find all galaxy positions and identify which rows and columns contain no galaxies. Rather than physically expanding the grid, add extra distance for each empty row/column crossed between a pair.

## Part 1

Each empty row or column doubles in size (expansion factor 2). For each galaxy pair, compute Manhattan distance and add 1 extra for each empty row/column in between.

## Part 2

Same logic but with expansion factor 1,000,000. Each empty row/column adds 999,999 extra to the distance. Since we never materialize the expanded grid, the computation is identical regardless of the expansion factor.
